data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): ACLI semantics correction. plugins/dso/scripts/acli-integration.py:752-796 shows search_issues(jql, start_at, max_results) returns a plain list slice (list[dict]) — NO total field, NO isLast field, NO pageToken returned. Reformulate the truncation gate without depending on those: trigger SilentTruncationError when cumulative collected >= 1000 AND the most recent page returned exactly page_size (100) AND no signal confirms working-set <1000. The epic Approach text references metadata/tokens that the current ACLI surface does not expose — implement the inferred-from-page-size form; if a future ACLI version exposes total/isLast/pageToken, layer that confirmation in additively.
